note: After Ruelle 1970 (pp. 391—393). The descriptions of the alate and the minor soldier are Ruelle's renderings of the original account by Grassé & Noirot 1951; the soldier measurements and the worker figures are Ruelle's own (marked below the tables, 13 specimens). The original is in English and the source description in French. The original uses hyphens in place of decimal points (e.g. 5-09-5-68, i.e. 5.09—5.68) and these have been converted. Only the four castes for which content was actually read are given here.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: A forest species of medium to small size. Major soldier: head in dorsal view distinctly narrowing forwards on both sides, the posterior corners rounded, the median part of the postmentum markedly narrowed; mandibles stout, the left mandible thicker than the right; antennae 17-segmented, segments 1 and 3 each twice as long as segment 2. Minor soldier: head narrowly oval, the fontanelle indistinct, the mandibles long and slender and almost straight, the antennae very long, extending backwards beyond the posterior margin of the metanotum by at least 3 segments; pronotum nearly hexagonal, the lateral corners almost not rounded. The head capsule bears distinctly more setae than in M. muelleri, and the major soldier is usually paler than in M. nobilis; the head of the minor soldier is thicker and less slender than in M. muelleri, and in lateral view the anterior third of the postmentum slopes down more steeply away from the head capsule, the postmentum itself being proportionally wider.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Ruelle's direct rendering of the original account by Grassé and Noirot (1951: 336): head dark reddish brown; anteclypeus very pale. Head slender, the sides narrowing forwards; anteclypeus small and swollen; fontanelle small but distinct. Compound eyes rather large; ocelli round and projecting, the distance from the ocellus to the compound eye equal to the ocellus diameter. Pronotum moderately saddle-shaped, nearly triangular in outline, the anterior margin straight with a very shallow median notch. Measurements: head width (across the compound eyes) 3.7 mm, compound eye diameter 1.0 mm, ocellus diameter 0.45 mm, pronotum width 3.52 mm, hind tibia length 4.4 mm; the corresponding values for a male alate from Port Harcourt, Nigeria, are 3.41, 0.98, 0.41, 3.18 and 4.0 mm. The type queen could not be examined.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier (after the original account by Grassé and Noirot, measurements supplemented by Ruelle, 9 specimens, 4 localities): head capsule red; mandibles black with red at the base; labrum red, its apex transparent and hairless; thoracic tergites dark brown, paler in the middle. Head in dorsal view distinctly narrowing forwards on both sides, the posterior corners rounded. Median part of the postmentum markedly narrowed. Mandibles stout, the left mandible thicker than the right. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 1 and 3 each twice as long as segment 2. Pronotum trapezoidal, the pro- and posterior margins slightly concave in the middle. Measurements: head length 5.09—5.68 (mean 5.39) mm, head width 4.34—4.89 (mean 4.63) mm, head depth including the postmentum 2.68—3.12 (mean 2.90) mm, left mandible length 2.99—3.25 (mean 3.12) mm, hind tibia length 4.05—4.64 (mean 4.33) mm, maximum length of the pronotum 1.64—1.95 (mean 1.77) mm, maximum width of the pronotum 2.95—3.55 (mean 3.21) mm. Minor soldier (after the original account by Grassé and Noirot, measurements supplemented by Ruelle, 11 specimens, 5 localities): reddish brown overall, the head redder; thoracic and abdominal tergites brown; legs and abdominal sternites paler. Head narrowly oval; fontanelle indistinct; mandibles long and slender, almost straight; median part of the postmentum but little constricted; labrum triangular and slender, slightly narrowed at the base, the transparent apex distinct; antennae 17-segmented and very long, extending backwards beyond the posterior margin of the metanotum by at least 3 segments; pronotum nearly hexagonal, the lateral corners almost not rounded; legs long and slender. Measurements: head length 2.05—2.50 (mean 2.21) mm, head width 1.46—1.86 (mean 1.65) mm, head depth including the postmentum 1.18—1.32 (mean 1.25) mm, postmentum length 1.36 and 1.41 mm (2 specimens), postmentum maximum width 0.59 and 0.62 mm (same specimens), left mandible length 1.59—1.84 (mean 1.68) mm, hind tibia length 3.21—3.55 (mean 3.35) mm, maximum length of the pronotum 0.91—1.03 (mean 0.96) mm, maximum width of the pronotum 1.32—1.59 (mean 1.43) mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: The major worker is smaller than in M. muelleri and M. nobilis: head width 2.21—2.67 mm, mean 2.47 mm (17 specimens, 4 localities).
